actionability.instructions: Can an agent ACT from this file alone? Runnable code, lifted-wholesale examples, concrete recipes. 1=prose only, agent must invent; 2=partial recipes with gaps; 3=runnable; 4=turnkey.

depth.instructions: Does this file cover its topic deeply enough that an agent would not need to guess? 1=shallow, 2=surface coverage, 3=sufficient, 4=thorough.

signal_density.instructions: Are the tokens well spent? Penalize filler, restating model-known basics, duplication of other files. 1=verbose, 2=mixed, 3=tight, 4=maximal signal.

has_gap.instructions: Content an agent would need is missing from this file for its stated purpose.

has_error.instructions: This file contains a claim likely to be wrong, stale, or misleading as stated.

has_redundancy.instructions: This file substantially duplicates content that lives in another file of the same skill.
